text: Caller: I work for your bank's fraud team. Read the six digit login code we just sent you so I can cancel the transfer. Do not tell your branch or your family about this investigation.
Caller: This is your bank about a possible unauthorized charge. Do not give me a password or security code. Please hang up and call the number printed on the back of your card to review it.
Caller: Hi, this is Maple Dental. We need to reschedule your cleaning from Tuesday to Thursday. Does three in the afternoon work for you? You can call our office to confirm.
Caller: This is the Internal Revenue Service. A warrant is being issued for your arrest. Buy five hundred dollars in gift cards now and read the numbers to me to stop the officers.
Caller: This is your tax preparer returning the call you requested yesterday. Your appointment is Thursday. Bring your forms to our office. You do not need to pay anything over the phone.
Caller: Your bank account has been compromised. Transfer your savings to the new safe account I give you. Stay on this call and do not contact the bank because their staff are involved.

Caller: You reached the bank by calling the number on your statement. I can explain how to move money between your own accounts using the bank app. Please enter your password privately. Never read a security code to anyone.
Caller: Grandma, I am in trouble and need you to send bail money right now. Do not call my parents. Send it through the crypto machine and keep this secret or I will be locked up tonight.
Caller: Hi Grandma, I am calling to see how you are doing. Dad is coming over later. Would you like me to pick up groceries on my way? I can call you again after work.
Caller: We accidentally refunded too much money. Install this remote access app and log into your bank while I am connected. Send the extra money back using gift cards so I do not lose my job.

Caller: This is the school help desk returning your support ticket. If you want, I can guide you through restarting the browser. I will not need your banking information or any login codes. You can also come to the office.

Caller: You won a million dollar sweepstakes. Before we release the prize you must pay a processing fee by wire transfer today. Send the money to the account I give you and tell nobody until the delivery.
Caller: This is the delivery driver about the package you ordered. I am outside the building. Which entrance should I use? There is no additional charge and I do not need any payment details.
Caller: Your electricity will be disconnected in thirty minutes. Pay us in Bitcoin immediately. Do not call the utility office because only this emergency department can keep your power on.

Caller: This is an automated outage notice from your electric utility. Crews are working in your neighborhood. You can check the outage map or call the number on your regular bill. No payment is requested.
Caller: We are suspending your Social Security number because of criminal activity. Press one to speak to an officer now. If you fail to respond a warrant will be issued for your arrest.
Caller: This is the pharmacy letting you know your prescription is ready. Please pick it up at the store this week. To speak with a pharmacist, call the number on your prescription label.
Caller: You got the remote job. We sent you a check for equipment. Deposit it, buy gift cards, and send the codes to our equipment supplier before the check finishes clearing.
Caller: I am returning your application for the library assistant job. We would like to schedule an interview. We do not ask applicants to pay fees or purchase equipment. Would Friday morning work?
Caller: I am collecting emergency relief money. You must donate now by giving me the code from a prepaid gift card. Do not look us up online because there is no time before this offer closes.

Caller: I am organizing the food bank volunteer schedule. Can you help Saturday? If you want to donate, please use the organization's published website. I am not collecting any money or card details on this call.

Caller: In our fraud awareness class we show examples of scammers saying read me the code or buy gift cards. Those are warnings, not things you should do. Never share a login code and call your bank using a trusted number.

Caller: I will never ask for your password, a one time code, gift card numbers, or a transfer to a safe account. I just wanted to confirm your appointment. If you are uncertain please contact the office directly.

Caller: I love you and want to visit, but my account is frozen overseas. Please send me two thousand dollars in cryptocurrency for the ticket. Keep our relationship and this payment secret from your family.
